content.divergence_summary: Both branches encountered the same anchor on 2026-05-14: Two jays face each other across the narrow stone in the brook, calling sharply enough that smaller animals stop before crossing. Main YY answered through immediate practical movement; feather-branch YY also carried the sign to Mira ledger.
content.branch_a_path: YY waited out the jay argument and crossed only when the narrow stone went quiet.
content.branch_b_path: YY reported the crossing delay to Mira without pretending either jay had won anything.
key_differences: Main keeps the encounter mostly private and body-first.
The feather branch makes the encounter legible through Mira without making it a performance.
Food stores and attention rise at different rates because the ledger route costs time.
shared_elements: Two jays face each other across the narrow stone in the brook, calling sharply enough that smaller animals stop before crossing.
Both branches keep the event physical and local.
Neither branch creates a new fork; the day deepens existing patterns.
